# 4 bed bungalow for sale

> A Fabulous Country Home on c.0.80 acre at Ringlestown, Kilmessan, Co Meath A 4 Bedroom Detached Bungalow Residence, its origins was a Traditional Land Commission Cottage on 22 Acres, evolved into a spacious and comfortable Bungalow in 1970's on an elevated site enjoying great views from front terrace over surrounding countryside.

- Lokalita: Ringlestown, Kilmessan
